app.title: Show HN: Npunlock – Run custom C kernels for Intel NPUs
app.author: hsfzxjy
app.description: Npunlock is a lightweight library that lets developers run custom C kernels directly on Intel NPUs, enabling low‑latency inference and training workloads without heavy frameworks.
